turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Hi Pat Romero, thanks for having me out today to look at your HVAC system.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thanks for coming, come on in.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: So tell me, what's prompting you to look into this now?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Honestly our old unit finally gave out last week.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Based on what we've walked through, the total price for this would be $4,200.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Let's go ahead and schedule this for next week, and I'll follow up tomorrow to confirm everything.
